RequiredDisclosures.Title: Temporary effect and alternatives
RequiredDisclosures.PlainLanguage: The expected effect is temporary. Results vary, and no treatment is an alternative.

RequiredDisclosures.Title: Who will perform the procedure
RequiredDisclosures.PlainLanguage: The care team must identify the proposed performer and explain the supervision pathway.

RequiredDisclosures.Title: Teach-back and unresolved holds
RequiredDisclosures.PlainLanguage: Signing is not enough: the patient must demonstrate understanding, and unresolved safety holds stop progression.
